_doc: AgentFlow plugin manifest (Task 7.2). Shape + fields from docs/capabilities.json zcode.manifest_fields.plugin_manifest: path .zcode-plugin/plugin.json; component_fields = [commands, skills, hooks, mcpServers, agents]; mcpServers shape <name>:{command,args[],cwd,env}; plugins expand ${ZCODE_PROJECT_DIR}/${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/${user_config.KEY}. HONESTY (P1-1: supported ≠ configured): docs/capabilities.json gates.tool_confirmation = value:false, class:fallback-capable, fallback:non_adversarial_convention. ZCode tool-level confirmation is NOT a per-tool manifest field — it is permissions.defaultMode + allow/deny rules in ~/.claude/settings.json, currently defaultMode=yolo/bypassPermissions (NOT enforced). The manifest therefore declares NO per-tool confirmation switch (declaring one would be fabrication) and instead records the confirmed fallback + the canonical security_warning (approval.SECURITY_WARNING, surfaced to the user per Spec §5.4/G6). The MCP surface is FIXED at exactly 9 tools (Spec §5.1, errata #8); abandon/archive are local admin commands and are NOT registered here.
name: zcode-agentflow
description: ZCode-supervised AgentFlow: Codex planner + Grok reviewer, versioned-file handoff, two human gates, terminal state READY_TO_MERGE (no auto push/merge).

toolConfirmation._doc: P1-1 honesty record. docs/capabilities.json proves ZCode SUPPORTS tool-level confirmation but it is NOT CONFIGURED in this env (defaultMode=yolo). A per-tool confirmation field does NOT exist in the plugin schema; this block records the confirmed state and surfaces the canonical security_warning so the reduced assurance is never hidden (Spec §5.4/G6). The non-adversarial convention flow (the actual fallback) is enforced by the Skill guidance, not by a manifest field. RUNTIME GATE: with the shipped config.yaml (human_gates.spec_approval.allow_non_adversarial_fallback=false) the server refuses to START (validate_capabilities raises CapabilityError, G6) rather than silently degrade; to actually run, the operator must either (a) set allow_non_adversarial_fallback=true to accept the reduced-assurance fallback, or (b) configure ~/.claude/settings.json so tool_confirmation is truly in effect.
toolConfirmation.config_location: ~/.claude/settings.json (permissions.defaultMode + allow/deny rules) — NOT a plugin manifest field

runtime_gate.startup_behavior: validate_capabilities RAISES CapabilityError (G6: fail loud, never silently degrade) — server does not start until the operator resolves this
runtime_gate.resolve: set human_gates.spec_approval.allow_non_adversarial_fallback=true (accept reduced assurance) OR configure ~/.claude/settings.json so tool_confirmation is in effect

toolConfirmation.security_warning: Security assurance is REDUCED: ZCode tool-level mandatory confirmation is not in effect for workflow_approve_spec. The approval used the non-adversarial convention flow, which relies on the model following guidance and does NOT defend against a malicious or coerced model. Verify this approval genuinely came from a human before proceeding.
